title: Definitions — The Fill Being Re-Dosed (Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit)
content:
**The fill being re-dosed.** For a dose-change override under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the fill being re-dosed depends on where the member's supply came from:

1. when the member has a Home Delivery Pharmacy shipment of the drug and it is dated later than the most recent paid retail claim for the drug, or that retail claim carries a reversal, the most recent shipment is the fill being re-dosed;
2. when, with no such shipment, the most recent paid retail claim carries a reversal, no supply was dispensed and the fill being re-dosed counts zero days;
3. otherwise it is the most recent paid retail claim.

**Date, days supply and quantity of the fill.** A shipment is dated by its shipment date and carries the days supply and quantity of the shipped Home Delivery Pharmacy order; the most recent shipment is the one with the latest shipment date. A retail claim is dated by its date of service and carries its own days supply and quantity. A member with a Home Delivery Pharmacy shipment of the drug and no paid retail claim for it falls under line 1.

## Examples (hypothetical records)

| Records for the drug | Fill being re-dosed |
|---|---|
| Retail claim dated March 2; Home Delivery Pharmacy shipment dated March 20 | The shipment of March 20 |
| Retail claim dated March 20; shipment dated March 2 | The retail claim of March 20 |
| Retail claim dated March 20 with a reversal; shipment dated March 2 | The shipment of March 2 |
| Retail claim dated March 20 with a reversal; no shipment | None dispensed: counts zero days |
| Shipment dated March 2; no retail claim | The shipment of March 2 |
